lines.text: In the days of Jehoiakim, God sent Jeremiah to bring the Rechabites into the LORD's house and offer them wine.
The Rechabites refused the wine because their forefather Jonadab commanded them never to drink it and to live in caves.
When Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched into the land, the Rechabites went into Jerusalem to escape the armies.
God said Jonadab's words had been carried out, but He sent all His servants the priests to Judah repeatedly.
God said He would bring disaster on Judah, and promised Jonadab would always have a man to stand before Him.
